name_en: Special Relief Assistance to Marine Fishermen Families during Fishing Lean Period
department: Department of Fisheries and Fishermen Welfare, Government of Tamil Nadu
benefit: Your marine fishing family gets Rs 6,000 as special relief during the lean fishing period.

other: You must be a member of a Fishermen Co-operative Society or the Tamil Nadu Fishermen Welfare Board.
You must work full time in fishing or fishing-related work.
You must have a valid ration card.
If you or your family members have a regular job or other income, you cannot get this.

documents: Co-operative Society membership proof or Fishermen Welfare Board card copy
Bank passbook first page copy (with photo)
Copy of enrolment through the e-Sevai centre
how_to_apply: Fill the application form. Attach your papers. You need to enrol through an e-Sevai centre.
